title: Normalized adic Weil system
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $q=p^a$, a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $A_n=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme and $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Use $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$ on the small pro-etale site as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. The coefficient sheaves $(A_n)_X$ are the constant sheaves of rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with the morphisms $(A_{n+1})_X\to(A_n)_X$ induced by the reductions, the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_X$ and its limit projections $\pi_n:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}\to(A_n)_X$, all as in [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients].

For $n\geq j\geq1$, write $r_{n,j}:D(X,A_j)\to D(X,A_n)$ for restriction of scalars along $(A_n)_X\to(A_j)_X$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], applied termwise to complexes [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]; restriction is exact since it leaves the underlying abelian sheaves and their kernels and cokernels unchanged. Write $\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}:D(X,A_n)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ for the derived restriction of scalars of [def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars], whose target uses the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_X$.

An *$A_\bullet$-system* on $X$ is a family
$$
K_\bullet=\bigl(K_n,t_{n+1,n}\bigr)_{n\geq1},\qquad
K_n\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n),\qquad
t_{n+1,n}:K_{n+1}\longrightarrow r_{n+1,n}K_n
$$
with the last arrow in $D(X,A_{n+1})$. For $n\geq j$, let $t_{n,j}:K_n\to r_{n,j}K_j$ be the composite of the adjacent transitions with the indicated restrictions of scalars, with $t_{n,n}=1$. It is *normalized* if the maps induced by these transitions under derived extension and restriction of scalars,
$$
\nu_{n,j}:K_n\otimes^L_{A_n}A_j\longrightarrow K_j,
$$
are isomorphisms for every $n\geq j\geq1$. Here derived change of rings is [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with the extension-restriction adjunction of [def-sfb-derived-extend-restrict-adjunction], applied in the category of sheaves of abelian groups on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to the ring objects $(A_n)_X\to(A_j)_X$, whose module objects are the sheaves of $(A_n)_X$- and $(A_j)_X$-modules; that category is Grothendieck abelian with an additive closed symmetric monoidal sheafified tensor product [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed] and has a functorial flat resolution [lem-sfb-sheaf-functorial-flat-resolution], applied to abelian groups with the free resolution $\mathbf Z[M]\to M$; the displayed maps are those adjoint to $t_{n,j}$, rather than unrelated choices of isomorphism. In particular $\nu_{n,n}=1$, and for $n\geq j\geq i$ the normalization maps obey
$$
\nu_{n,i}=\nu_{j,i}\circ(\nu_{n,j}\otimes^L_{A_j}A_i)
$$
under the associativity identification of the derived tensor products.

A morphism $f_\bullet:K_\bullet\to L_\bullet$ is a family $f_n:K_n\to L_n$ in $D(X,A_n)$ satisfying
$$
r_{n+1,n}(f_n)\circ t^K_{n+1,n}=t^L_{n+1,n}\circ f_{n+1}
\qquad(n\geq1).
$$
Identities and composition are levelwise.

The restricted objects $M_n=\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}K_n$ and restricted transitions form an inverse system in the single category $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, using $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,X}\circ r_{n+1,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}$ (the composite of $\pi_{n+1}$ with $(A_{n+1})_X\to(A_n)_X$ is $\pi_n$). Countable products of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$-modules exist and are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact], so the product $\prod_{n\geq1}M_n$ exists in $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ [lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core]. An *integral realization* of this system, denoted
$$
K_{\mathcal O_E}=R\!\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_{n,X}K_n,
$$
is an object equipped with a Roos triangle as in [def-weil-derived-limit]:
$$
K_{\mathcal O_E}\longrightarrow\prod_{n\geq1}M_n
\xrightarrow{\,1-s\,}\prod_{n\geq1}M_n
\longrightarrow K_{\mathcal O_E}[1],
$$
where $\mathrm{pr}_n s=\overline t_{n+1,n}\mathrm{pr}_{n+1}$ and $\overline t$ denotes the transition after restriction to the completed coefficient sheaf. This specifies the derived-limit property and its triangle, without a choice of a derived-limit functor on the category of systems.

Let $\mathcal D^b_{ctf,\mathrm W,adic}(X,\mathcal O_E)$ be the category whose objects are normalized $A_\bullet$-systems equipped at each level with a strict Weil structure
$$
\varphi_n:Lg_\gamma^*K_n\xrightarrow{\sim}K_n
$$
in the sense of [def-trf-strict-weil-complex], where $g_\gamma$ is the geometric-Frobenius automorphism specified there. Require
$$
t_{n+1,n}\circ\varphi_{n+1}
=r_{n+1,n}(\varphi_n)\circ Lg_\gamma^*(t_{n+1,n})
$$
under the coefficient identification $Lg_\gamma^*r_{n+1,n}=r_{n+1,n}Lg_\gamma^*$. Morphisms are the morphisms of systems just defined which also satisfy
$$
f_n\circ\varphi_n^K=\varphi_n^L\circ Lg_\gamma^*(f_n)
\qquad(n\geq1).
$$
Identities and composition are levelwise.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q75-e90a66d88 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item. Both blueprint snapshots (master order 2385, main-20261015 order 2729) have the same text, and I read that, the sk-prop-trace-adic unit and its section, Stacks derived.tex 08TC (lines 10436-10460), every cited node, the five citers, and the nearest candidate duplicate, def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower. That node requires a coherent D(Tow) lift and has no ctf condition, so it is a different notion. The repaired definition is correct. The transitions K_{n+1}->r K_n are properly typed. Normalization uses the maps adjoint to the transitions; arbitrary isomorphisms would let a zero-transition tower count as normalized. The cocycle follows by mates. Morphisms are levelwise. The realization is the object-only Roos derived limit, which is right because a family in varying D(X,A_n) gives no D(Tow) object; the sign matches 08TC. The strict-Weil compatibility is well typed. Removing the reconstruction sentence is justified: it is a claim, the unit's step (i) states it under an extra hypothesis, and no citer uses it from here. Uniform Tor amplitude follows from K_1, so no hypothesis was added. Small cases checked: empty X, a point with A_n^r (r=0 included), n=j, the zero-transition tower, and a moving skyscraper with no phi_n. No new nodes, no tool_uses. Three repairs are in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-trace-formula/def-trf-adic-system.json. (1) The coefficient sheaves came from def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum (Cont(pi_0) sheaves, with no identification with the constant sheaves), while D^b_ctf and Res_{n,X} use def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients. I switched to that node, dropped the adic-datum dependency, and made Res_{n+1}r_{n+1,n}=Res_n explicit. (2) 08TC needs the product prod M_n to exist; I added lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact and lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core. (3) The hypotheses of def-sfb-derived-extend-restrict-adjunction were not supplied; I added the ambient sheaves of abelian groups on X_proet, with lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed and lem-sfb-sheaf-functorial-flat-resolution. None of the added nodes leads back to the item, and the citations match stmt_deps.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
